name: rizo
description: BYOK AI coding assistant: cost-optimized model routing, file edit, terminal, git, all through your own OpenRouter key.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Rizo reads and edits files and runs commands in your workspace, so it only runs in folders you trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Rizo needs files on disk and a terminal.

rizo.permissions.autoApproveCommandPatte.markdownDescription: Regular expressions for `run_command` commands that may run without the approval dialog. Each pattern must match the **whole** command (`npm test` approves exactly `npm test`; use `npm test( .*)?` to allow arguments). Commands that chain, pipe, substitute or redirect (`;` `&&` `|` `` ` `` `$(` `>` `<`) always ask. **Destructive commands always ask** (force-push, `reset --hard`, `branch -D`, `rm -rf`, etc.). This is a user setting only: a workspace's own settings can't change it.

rizo.permissions.disabledTools.description: Tools listed here are refused outright and not offered to the model at all in this workspace.

rizo.inlineEdit.model.markdownDescription: OpenRouter model id used by **Rizo: Edit Selection** (`Cmd+Alt+K` / `Ctrl+Alt+K`), for example `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`.

rizo.autocomplete.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Rizo's code suggestions as you type (`Tab` accepts). Off by default: every suggestion is a small paid request to `#rizo.autocomplete.model#`. Files that usually hold secrets (`.env`, keys) are never sent.

rizo.autocomplete.model.markdownDescription: OpenRouter model id for autocomplete. A fast, cheap model works best.

command.description: Program that starts a local server (no shell).

env.description: Extra environment variables for this server, for example its API token.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint of a remote server (https, or http://localhost).

rizo.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: MCP servers whose tools Rizo can use (not in Plan mode). A local server: `{ "github": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"], "env": { "GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN": "..." } } }`. A remote one: `{ "docs": { "url": "https://example.com/mcp" } }`. Rizo asks before every tool call. This is a user setting only: a workspace can't add servers.

rizo.permissions.passEnvironmentVariable.markdownDescription: Commands Rizo runs get your editor's environment **minus variables that usually hold credentials** (names containing `TOKEN`, `SECRET`, `PASSWORD`, `API_KEY`, and prefixes like `AWS_`, `AZURE_`, `GH_`, `NPM_TOKEN`). List variable names here to pass them through anyway, for example `AWS_PROFILE`. This is a user setting only: a workspace's own settings can't change it.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line
Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends, Enter alone makes a new line
rizo.composer.sendKey.description: Which key sends a message from the composer.

rizo.view.focusMode.description: Hide tool-call activity in the chat, showing only your prompts and the final answers.

rizo.todoCodeLens.enabled.description: Show an "Implement with Rizo" CodeLens above TODO/FIXME comments.

rizo.limits.maxStepsPerTurn.markdownDescription: Most tool-call steps one reply may take before Rizo pauses and asks you to say *continue*. `0` (the default) means **no limit**: a reply runs until the model is done or you press **Stop**.

rizo.limits.maxOutputTokens.markdownDescription: Most tokens a single model response may use. `0` (the default) means **each model's own maximum**, read from OpenRouter's model list. If your OpenRouter credit can't cover that, Rizo automatically asks for what it can afford.
